verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline as the main element and the CTA at a sensible size. However, the headline wraps and leaves 'fizz' alone on its own line, the CITRINE logo sits tight against the top edge, and the stack sits high with only the olive circle filling the bottom. B centres the stack better, but its CTA pill is blown up to almost full width with thin side margins and becomes a white block that competes with the smaller headline; it also has the same orphaned 'fizz' and leaves empty space at the top.
